summary: The team finalized updates to the CASOM document, clarifying the motivation for extending existing O&M frameworks to cover surface instances and preventing traffic steering failures due to unmonitored service crashes. Four new O&M components were defined within the updated layering model: SIOM for instance status and metric monitoring, and SVCOM for policy verification, rule checking, and end-to-end latency measurement across multi-domain environments.
